P.name: Noxious Slipstream
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Singed''' moves near a {{tip|champion}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Noxious Slipstream'' for 2 seconds, refreshing on subsequent passes and stacking up to 25 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Noxious Slipstream:}} For each stack, '''Singed''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|25% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|625%|ms}}.
P.description3: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

Q.name: Poison Trail
Q.description:
{{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Singed''' continually creates a toxic cloud in his wake that lingers for {{fd|3.25}} seconds. The cloud inflicts {{tip|poison}} to enemies within.

''Poison Trail'' is toggled off automatically if '''Singed''' becomes unable to pay its {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over 2 seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently affected. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|20/4 to 60/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|42.5/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{fd|42.5}}% AP)}}|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|(20/4)*8 to (60/4)*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|(42.5/4)*8}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: '''Singed''' earns the kill credit of enemy {{tip|minions}} that are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} and would die to the damage of allied minions within the time before the next damage instance.

W.name: Mega Adhesive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Singed''' spills a potent adhesive that lands at the target location after {{fd|0.375}} seconds, creating a field for 3 seconds that {{tip|ground|grounds}} enemies within and {{tip|slows}} them.

E.name: Fling
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Singed''' {{tip|airborne|flings}} the target enemy 550 units over himself over {{rutngt|0.666}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 90}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6 to 8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}
E.description2: If the target lands on ''{{ais|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}'' area of effect after the displacement, they are {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration.

R.name: Insanity Potion
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Singed''' empowers himself for 25 seconds with {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Stats|{{ap|25 to 85}}}}
{{st|HP/Mana Regenerated per {{fd|0.5}} Seconds|{{ap|25/10 to 85/10}}|Total HP/Mana Regenerated over the duration|{{ap|25*5 to 85*5}}}}
R.description2: During this time, ''{{ai|Poison Trail|Singed}}'' additionally applies {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} for 1 second, which refreshes every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the {{tip|poison}} persists.
